title: Plan 5 drafted from dogfood pivot — showcase-only, no subtree
body: Operator pivot post-Plan 4 close-out: rather than subtreeing the architecture module into every downstream repo, run DontPanic's capabilities FROM DontPanic against our own repos and publish the artifacts as docs/showcase/. The showcase IS the product demonstration. Two-feature shape: F001 = showcase generator + redactor + sanitization extension + per-target artifact matrix + CLI flag wire-throughs (--plans-root for validate-plans-strict, --architecture-json for drift), F002 = docs/showcase/README.md index + repo README pointer + scripts/showcase.sh wrapper + Makefile target + deferral-trigger documentation. v0 targets 4 repos: DontPanic (architecture + validate-plans + drift), agent-conventions (architecture + validate-plans if plan dirs exist), axiom (architecture only), one of {SpinDine, Glam} operator-pickable (architecture + validate-plans if plan dirs exist). Forbidden_decisions codify the operator's three concrete deferral triggers for promoting a target from showcase-only to local integration: (a) target repo wants committed architecture.json for offline/contributor consumption; (b) target repo wants drift checks wired into its OWN CI; (c) target repo has active non-DontPanic contributors who need the map in-repo. Until one fires, dogfood is showcase-only. Sanitization is mandatory (redactor strips absolute paths; sanitization_check extended to scan docs/showcase/; target-repo audit/evidence content NEVER reaches showcase output). No auto-regen — explicit operator command only. Dependencies: Plan 4 (architecture surface — commit 5e27286) + Plan 3 (strict-plan-validate probe — commit c104c22). Plan 5 (agent-conventions remote) is NOT a dependency; showcase uses local checkout. Status:draft awaiting operator lock signal.

title: Lock: status:draft → active + Glam selected as 4th target
body: Plan reviewed; all four artifacts (plan.md, features.json, objective_contract.json, decisions.jsonl) validate clean against v1.0 schemas. SpinDine|Glam choice resolved: GLAM is the 4th target. Rationale: Glam has the larger module surface — the architecture map will be more visually striking + better showcase material for the schema-repo-becomes-legible argument applied to a complex app. SpinDine deferred to a follow-on showcase expansion if Glam lands well. F001 default showcase config: dontpanic (all 3 artifacts) + agent-conventions (architecture + validate-plans if plan dirs exist) + axiom (architecture only) + glam (architecture + validate-plans if plan dirs exist). Operator can override at generation time via --target=<repo_key>. F001 dispatching solo first (high collision risk with Plan 2 F001 on scripts/dontpanic_doctor.py + scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/cli.py — both want to add new CLI flags to the doctor subcommand; sequential dispatch avoids the rerun churn we'd otherwise pay).

title: LLM sufficiency audit explicitly skipped — operator review serves as the sufficiency analysis
body: `dontpanic plan lock` enforces a pre-impl sufficiency-findings.json artifact (Goal Governance V1 F003) before status:draft→active. The artifact normally requires a paid LLM auditor call against the objective_contract's user journeys. For Plan 5: skipped the LLM call and authored evidence/goal-governance/pre_impl/sufficiency-findings.json with auditor='operator' + empty findings array + an _operator_note explaining the substitution. Rationale: operator already did substantive pre-lock review captured in D002 (1 blocker + 6 high-risk + 4 medium issues resolved against the same objective_contract surface the LLM auditor would walk); v0 is thin orchestration over already-shipped capabilities (no new runtime infra); quota conservation matters. The empty findings array means no sufficiency gaps to override (--ignore-sufficiency-findings flag is moot). This is a precedent — future plans with operator-authored sufficiency reviews can use the same pattern: write findings.json with auditor='operator' + a substantive _operator_note. Plan 5 status now: active. F001 ready for dispatch.

title: F001 close-out: stopped_no_progress (high-security sanitization split + 4-target fixture hand-patched)
body: Plan 5 F001 terminated stopped_no_progress after 2 rounds (iter0+iter1 both needs_changes; classifier taxonomy=unknown because finding #1 was a real security defect but finding #2 was missing-coverage). Two findings both hand-patched at close-out: (1) HIGH/security — original implementation placed docs/showcase/ in ALLOWED_PREFIXES, which makes is_allowed() return True and main() SKIP scan_line entirely; that meant secret-shape regexes never ran on showcase artifacts. Auditor proved this with a fake `AKIA...` line under docs/showcase/leaky.json. Fix: introduced new CAMPAIGN_IDS_OK_BUT_SCAN_SECRETS tier with corresponding allows_campaign_ids_only() predicate; scan_line() grew a secrets_only=True path; main() threads it through. docs/showcase/ moved from ALLOWED_PREFIXES to the split tier. (2) MEDIUM/test_coverage — added test_generator_with_four_targets_produces_expected_artifact_matrix covering the full v0 acceptance matrix (dontpanic-syn full / conventions-syn arch+validate / axiom-syn arch / glam-syn arch+validate) including redaction invariant + per-target supported_artifacts honored. Also tightened the existing sanitization test to assert the split-policy contract (docs/showcase NOT in ALLOWED_PREFIXES; IS in CAMPAIGN_IDS_OK_BUT_SCAN_SECRETS; scan_line(secrets_only=True) catches secrets but skips campaign IDs). Full sweep 2072 passed / 7 skipped (+22 showcase tests including new 4-target fixture). Sanitization clean (1333 files). Operator-resolved as implementation_defect_patched. v5 carry candidate noted: classifier returned aggregate=unknown because the test_coverage finding didn't match the closed taxonomy v0 vocabulary; review whether missing-coverage findings should classify as implementation_defect by default.
